hooks.command: GR_DIR=UNSET; for d in "$GUARDRAILS_HOOKS_DIR" "$GR_DIR" "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/guardrails" "$HOME/.claude/hooks/guardrails"; do [ -n "$d" ] && [ -f "$d/guard_prompt.py" ] && exec python3 "$d/guard_prompt.py"; done; case "$GR_DIR" in UNSET|off) exit 0 ;; esac; echo "guardrails: guard_prompt.py not found in $GR_DIR. Reinstall it or re-run the guardrails setup." >&2; exit 2
